name: Firing Line
strategy: Maintain ranged superiority through coordinated shooting, accuracy, and fire discipline.

commands.name: Concentrated Fire
commands.effect: If the active Unit has not voluntarily Moved, Disengaged, or Blinked this Round, it gains +2 Attack dice on its next ranged Attack this Assault Phase.

commands.name: Marked Fire Lane
commands.effect: When the active Unit declares its next ranged Attack this Assault Phase, gain Pinpoint, ignore Concealed for targeting that Attack, and reduce the target's effective Cover X by up to 2 (minimum 0). Suppressing Cover rerolls does not remove Evade eligibility provided by Cover; ignoring Concealed does not remove the condition.

commands.name: Artillery Correction
commands.effect: When the active Unit makes its next Heavy ranged Attack this Assault Phase, gain +1 Attack die and reduce the target's effective Cover X by up to 2 (minimum 0) against that Attack. Suppressing Cover rerolls does not remove Cover-granted Evade eligibility.

commands.name: Veteran Gunners
commands.effect: The active Unit gains +1 Attack and Accurate 1 on its next ranged Attack against an enemy that was already attacked at range by a different friendly Unit this Round.

commands.name: Screening Fire
commands.effect: When an enemy within range of a friendly Unit's ranged weapon declares a Charge, the enemy worsens Hit by one step on its first Melee Attack during the ensuing Combat Phase.

doctrineIdentity: Offensive ranged combat. Firing Line is especially effective with conventional archers, gun lines, and artillery but remains usable by any Unit possessing a ranged weapon.
